page.layout: One printed page. At the top right, the page number. Below it, an ornamental border. Then a centred title block of three heading lines. Below that, one column of running text with a large woodcut initial V. In the right margin beside the first lines, a three-word note. At the foot, a signature at the left and a catchword at the right.

main_text.l: omnibus fere rebus ejus magnis bello ac
pace implicita; denique Reip. formâ præ
sim quædam de eâ disserere, & explica-
stratis. Et primùm quidem de agro di-
cam breviter, in quo urbs sita est, de-
tum de ipsa urbe, de jure Ultrajectino,
de pactis & fœderibus ejus, de conatu & armis

page.notes: The large initial V is a woodcut and is joined to "Rbs" as printed. The right margin has a three-word note, "Summa / operis / ordo", set beside the line "agro di-cam", with a small ornamental mark. The oval stamp at the right margin is a library seal and is left out. The page number "1" is partly unclear and is marked [?]. The catchword "armis" is printed at the foot, right, under the last line. The running text ends mid-sentence because the page continues.
